caption:
An unanswered lead doesn't just sit there. It compounds.

Every hour of silence adds interest: ad spend that already produced nothing, a competitor who picks up first, and a story your prospect tells a neighbor about calling and getting nothing back.

Industry research shows only 17% of service businesses answer a lead within an hour. Answering within 5 minutes can roughly double the close rate on that same lead.

Pull your last 10 leads this week. Compare when they came in to when someone replied. That gap is your interest rate.
